messages.subject: choose.files
parts:
Dear all,

I'm having some troubles trying to put many txt files in a vector. I'
m using scan as usual, but now it will be read only the first file..?
¿? Somebody has an idea of what is wrong??


> texto<-scan(file=choose.files(), what="char", sep="\n")
Read 2873 items
Warning messages:
1: In if (file == "") file <- stdin() else { :
la condición tiene longitud > 1 y sólo el primer elemento será usado
2: In file(file, "r") :
sólo fue usado el primer elemento del argumento 'description'

thanks

messages.author: 3edc58ee737edd94
messages.subject: Re: [CorpLing with R] choose.files
parts:
The function scan only accepts one file argument to load. If you want
to load several files, then you can loop:

files.to.load <- choose.files()
for (current.files in files.to.load) {
current.file <- scan(files.to.load, ...)
stuff
}

HTH,
STG
